description: RK1828 (RKNN3) LLM worker runtime — staged build artifact, mirroring deploy/rk-runtime/. Rebuild per services/rk1828-llm/BUILD.md.
note: Layout is load-bearing: the binary's rpath is $ORIGIN/lib, so librknn3_api.so must stay in lib/ next to it. CRITICAL: librknn3_api.so is only a 55 KB dispatch shim that dlopen()s librknn3_api_rkcp.so (search order: ./, ./lib/, /usr/local/lib, /usr/lib, /usr/lib64). Because that is a dlopen and not a link-time dependency, `ldd` on the binary looks perfectly clean when the backend is absent, and the failure surfaces only as `rknn_init fail ret=-1` at model load. The whole lib/ directory must be staged, not just librknn3_api.so.

worker_source.note: Server-mode conversion of the model zoo's one-shot Qwen3 demo; pristine upstream is main.cc.oneshot.bak on the build device.

lib/librknn3_api_rkcp.so.role: the actual RKNN3 implementation, loaded via dlopen at rknn_init; REQUIRED

lib/librga.so.role: Rockchip RGA; shipped alongside in the model-zoo install tree
